scope: Conditional stability of fixed, adaptively selected training-Folds-1-4 OOF forecasts; not fresh generalization evidence or a selection-adjusted confidence statement.

integrity.scope: H11 internal artifact consistency; no original data, held-out targets, or upstream result files reopened

primary_block_components.grouping: union of actual block IDs sharing an identical nominal issue-target day pair
primary_block_components.duplicate_weighting: all original windows retained, including repeated issue-target pairs
primary_block_components.resampling: sample cluster_count clusters uniformly with replacement; paired draws shared across models and thresholds
primary_block_components.delta_sign: challenger minus reference; negative favors challenger

registered_stability_hypothesis.rule: If a non-P0 candidate was adopted, BOTH groupings require overall delta interval upper < 0 and observed-fast500 delta interval upper <= 0.01 * P0 fast500 RMSE; no adoption is inconclusive.
registered_stability_hypothesis.freeze_action: Freeze the portfolio after artifact integrity passes regardless of interval direction; no audit-driven refitting or reselection.

limitations: Predictions, fitted models, candidate choices, and original-window duplicate weighting remain fixed.
Resampling does not account for adaptive hypothesis design, model-selection optimism, or fitting uncertainty.
Dependence beyond either prespecified grouping may remain; grouping sensitivity is reported without choosing the favorable result.
Intervals and sign fractions are conditional resampling diagnostics, not p-values or new model-promotion rules.
The >=600 km/s threshold remains secondary, including unfavorable or undefined results.
